objectives.text: Troubleshoot clusters and nodes
Troubleshoot cluster components (API server, etcd, controller manager, scheduler)
Monitor cluster and application resource usage
Manage and evaluate container output streams and logging
Troubleshoot services, DNS resolution, and networking plumbing
Manage Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and service accounts
Prepare underlying infrastructure for installing a Kubernetes cluster
Create and manage Kubernetes clusters using kubeadm (kubeadm init, kubeadm join)
Manage the lifecycle of Kubernetes clusters (including version upgrades)
Implement and configure a highly-available control plane
Implement etcd snapshot backup and restore procedures
Use Helm and Kustomize to deploy application and cluster components
Understand extension interfaces (CNI, CSI, CRI), CRDs, and operators
Understand connectivity between Pods and node-to-pod networking
Define and enforce NetworkPolicies to restrict ingress and egress traffic
Configure Service types (ClusterIP, NodePort, LoadBalancer, ExternalName) and Endpoints
Use Ingress controllers, Ingress resources, and the Gateway API
Configure and troubleshoot cluster CoreDNS resolution
Understand application deployments, rolling updates, and rollbacks
Use ConfigMaps and Secrets to configure applications
Configure workload autoscaling using Horizontal Pod Autoscaler (HPA)
Create and manage Deployments, StatefulSets, DaemonSets, Jobs, and CronJobs
Understand scheduling primitives: node selectors, node affinity, taints, tolerations, and pod affinity
Understand StorageClasses and configure dynamic volume provisioning
Configure volume types, access modes (RWO, ROX, RWX), and reclaim policies
Manage Persistent Volumes (PVs) and Persistent Volume Claims (PVCs)
